packages.name: Google Play services
packages.summary: Core Google services framework. Everything else depends on it. On Android 17 the bulk of it ships as an apex; the priv-app directory holds only the Chimera modules.

packages.name: Google Services Framework
packages.summary: Device registration and push messaging.

packages.name: Google Play Store
packages.summary: App store and Play Protect.

packages.name: Google Setup Wizard
packages.summary: Replaces the ROM's first-boot flow. Needed to sign in during setup; without it you sign in from Settings afterwards.

packages.name: Google Restore
packages.summary: Restores apps and settings from a previous device during setup.

packages.name: Search engine selector
packages.summary: The search engine choice screen shown during setup in the EEA.

packages.name: Google app and Assistant
packages.summary: Search, Assistant and the at-a-glance widget. Large (~350 MB).

packages.name: Google Phone
packages.summary: Call screening and spam protection.

packages.name: Google Messages
packages.summary: RCS-capable SMS client.

packages.name: Gboard
packages.summary: Includes the offline speech models and the CJK language models, which live outside the app directory. Without them voice typing only works online and Japanese, Korean and Chinese input is degraded.

packages.name: Markup
packages.summary: The annotation editor Photos and screenshots open.

packages.name: Trichrome shared library
packages.summary: Code Chrome and the Google WebView share. Both declare it with uses-static-library and neither loads without it, so it is its own package rather than living inside either one.

packages.name: Pixel Launcher
packages.summary: Pixel home screen. Pair with gsa for the search bar.

packages.name: Device Personalization Services
packages.summary: On-device personalisation: app suggestions, smart text selection, Now Playing and Live Caption all route through it.

packages.name: AICore
packages.summary: On-device foundation models the newer Pixel features build on.

packages.name: Android Device Policy
packages.summary: Work profile and managed device support.

packages.name: Credential Manager
packages.summary: Passkey and password autofill support.

packages.name: Google document picker
packages.summary: Replaces the AOSP picker, which is what every app opens when asking you to choose a file.

packages.name: Google Feedback
packages.summary: Reports problems to Google. Harmless to leave out.

packages.name: Contacts and Calendar sync adapters
packages.summary: The standalone sync adapters, kanged rather than dumped: no Pixel image from Android 13 on ships them, because modern Play services handles account sync itself. Offered for ROMs that still expect them, and off by default because on a Pixel they are redundant.

packages.name: Pixel sounds
packages.summary: The Pixel ringtones, alarms and notification sounds, plus the picker that exposes them.

packages.name: Google Text-to-Speech
packages.summary: Includes the offline voice data, which lives outside the app directory. Without it only the languages downloaded on demand will speak.

packages.name: eSIM support
packages.summary: Needed for eSIM provisioning on most carriers.

packages.name: TalkBack
packages.summary: Screen reader. The one accessibility service most users need.

packages.name: Switch Access
packages.summary: Control the device with switches rather than the touchscreen.

packages.name: Voice Access
packages.summary: Control the device by voice.

packages.name: Sound Amplifier
packages.summary: Amplifies and filters audio through headphones.
